kept_evidence.summary: Morgan Stanley Research estimates that NVIDIA's Vera Rubin VR200 NVL72 rack will cost hyperscale cloud providers about $7.8 million per unit, up from roughly $4 million for the current GB300 NVL72 generation. It estimates NVIDIA will charge about $55,000 per Rubin GPU and $5,000 per Vera CPU when sold in volume. It puts memory content at about $2 million per rack, a 435% jump from the prior generation, driven by a threefold increase in LPDDR5X capacity to 54 terabytes per rack plus roughly $1 million or more in 3D NAND storage. Memory's share of the bill of materials rises to 25-30% on VR200 from 5-10% on GB200, while the GPU share falls from roughly 63% to 51%.
